matchDays.label: A payment matches the ERP's within (days)
matchDays.help: A payment you recorded as "paid to ERP" and the payment the ERP's Accounts team recorded are the same when the amount and the reference are the same and the dates are at most this many days apart. One without a match on the other side is shown as a difference.

lookbackDays.label: Read the ERP's statement back (days)
lookbackDays.help: Every account check reads the ERP's statement this many days back, so a payment whose message never arrived is still written into the books.

pageSize.label: Rows per page in Money → Books
pageSize.help: How many ledger entries, payments or pieces one page shows.

checkMinutes.label: Look for the nightly close every (minutes)
checkMinutes.help: How often the shop looks whether the nightly close time has passed. The close itself runs once a night.

days.label: Check closed days again (days back)
days.help: Every run also checks this many closed days before it. A day whose own money moved after it matched is shown as a difference. A day whose ledger changed since its close (a correction, fixed costs or a summary entered later) is always checked again.

reasonMinLength.label: Shortest reason for a correction (letters)
reasonMinLength.help: A correction of the books, a month closed with differences or a month opened again needs a reason at least this long. It stays in the history.

minLength.label: Owner's PIN: shortest length (digits)
minLength.help: The PIN asked for every correction and close. Digits only; one digit repeated or a straight run (123456) is refused.

maxAttempts.label: Wrong PIN tries before a lock
maxAttempts.help: After this many wrong tries in a row by one person, the PIN is locked for that person for a while, even the right PIN.

lockMinutes.label: PIN lock (minutes)
lockMinutes.help: How long the PIN stays locked after too many wrong tries.

staleMinutes.label: A books run counts as stopped after (minutes)
staleMinutes.help: Only one run of the books at a time. A run still shown as running after this long is treated as stopped, so the next one can start.
